rules.title: Database access goes through the query builder
rules.description: Never build SQL by string concatenation or template literals; use the builders in packages/db.

rules.title: Secrets come from doppler
rules.description: Read credentials from process.env as injected by doppler; never commit .env files or hardcode keys.

rules.title: No any in TypeScript
rules.description: Use unknown and narrow it; an explicit any fails review.

rules.title: Bug fixes carry a failing test
rules.description: A bug-fix change includes a test that fails without the fix.

rules.title: Validate every request body with zod
rules.description: Each route parses its body with a zod schema from apps/api/src/schemas before touching it.

rules.title: Errors are problem+json
rules.description: Route handlers return errors through problem() so clients get application/problem+json.

rules.title: Default to server components
rules.description: Add use client only to components that need state or browser APIs.

rules.title: Prefer loaders over fetch in useEffect
rules.description: Data fetching belongs in route loaders; useEffect fetches are acceptable for polling only.

rules.title: Never edit a committed migration
rules.description: Add a new migration instead; committed files under packages/db/migrations are applied in production.
